survived_independent_check.note: passes only at the loop's loose threshold; not significant at 0.05

honest_conclusion: Nothing found here is a solution anyone should copy. Three of the four units are small island states whose child-mortality figures are modelled estimates with wide uncertainty; the fourth, Syria, is conflict-affected, where a low modelled estimate is more plausibly a data artefact than a success. Only one brief passed the independent practice check, at adjusted p = 0.096. Predictions cannot be scored before the next 30-day data refresh, so the loop has no measured hit rate yet.
